canada.title: 'The woman from the hole': Winnipegger's comical quandary becomes Halloween costume
canada.summary: Christine Keilback might have the greatest sense of humour ever. She laughed off her misfortune after plunging shoulder-deep into a hole in a boulevard, and now she's getting a howl out of a Halloween costume inspired by it all.

canada.title: Homicide unit investigating after man and woman in 50s found dead near Beechy, Sask.
canada.summary: A man and a woman in their 50s were found dead in a home near Beechy, Sask. RCMP say the woman's death is suspicious, but the man's is not.

canada.title: Some Alberta pharmacists say they’re having trouble getting enough stock of COVID-19 vaccines
canada.summary: This fall, unlike last year, the province is allowing pharmacists to give out COVID-19 shots. But some pharmacists say they are not getting full shipments of the doses they have ordered.

canada.title: 3rd person charged with 2nd-degree murder in death of Regina woman
canada.summary: Rebecca Autumn (Wilson) Mathieson, 37, was found seriously injured in an alley on Aug. 14 and died on Aug. 30. Kaylee Pelletier, 21, is charged with second-degree murder, according to Regina police.

canada.title: Montreal mayor backs police chief amid misconduct allegations against officers
canada.summary: Soraya Martinez Ferrada says Fady Dagher understands that the trust between the public and Service de police de la Ville de Montréal is paramount in Quebec’s largest city.

canada.title: New trial ordered for driver acquitted in crash that killed Vancouver toddler
canada.summary: Canada's top court has ordered a new trial for a man acquitted of dangerous driving charges in a crash that killed a B.C. toddler in 2021.

canada.title: 'You can't just get out': How 2 boys were recruited into the drug trade at the age of 12
canada.summary: Drug trafficking networks that have been recruiting young Black boys who have gone missing in the Greater Toronto Area are coercing even younger kids from cities across Canada and sending them even further to sell drugs, an investigation by CBC’s the fifth estate has found.

canada.title: How Nova Scotia has revived its ‘crime shouldn’t pay’ law
canada.summary: A two-decade-old law the Nova Scotia government overhauled last year with little fanfare is now being deployed to more easily seek the forfeiture of tens of thousands of dollars in suspected proceeds of crime and vehicles ranging from an Audi to Ford F-150 pickups.

canada.title: Patrick Stewart found ‘Star Trek’ fame but always returned to Shakespeare and the stage
canada.summary: LONDON (AP) — Before he captained the Starship Enterprise, Patrick Stewart commanded the Shakespearean stage.

canada.title: N.S. school support workers to file 48-hour strike notice after talks break down
canada.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia says it will be filing a 48-hour strike notice, after talks broke down with the province overnight.

canada.title: New Brunswick’s surplus power sales to U.S. could close Irving Paper, firm warns
canada.summary: New Brunswick's Crown-owned electric utility is being criticized for changing its policy on the sale of excess power.

canada.title: Ottawa inspired by NAFTA as it pursues a new Canada-EU alliance, Joly says
canada.summary: Ottawa is drawing inspiration from the North American Free Trade Agreement as it works to develop a new alliance with the European Union, Industry Minister Mélanie Joly says.

canada.title: Fort Smith animal shelter to close Sunday as town plans transition to pound
canada.summary: Facing chronic volunteer burnout and lack of staffing, the Fort Smith Animal Shelter will cease volunteer operations on Nov. 1. The facility is expected to transition to a town-operated pound, and volunteers are making urgent plea to community for remaining dogs.

canada.title: New Deer Lake clinic sits empty, with opening date unknown, amid road connection dispute
canada.summary: A brand new 30,000-square-foot community health clinic in Deer Lake is stuck in limbo more than two months after construction ended at the facility in August.

canada.title: Yes, Halloween candy is expensive this year — but some sweets are scarier than others
canada.summary: Candy prices have climbed steadily over the past six years, according to Statistics Canada inflation numbers. But some treats are trickier than others. We break down which candies got more expensive this Halloween.

canada.title: Permanent daylight time could cause technical issues for some Manitoba businesses
canada.summary: Manitoba clocks won't be falling back this weekend, but the permanent change to daylight time might cause some confusion for Manitoba business owners.

canada.title: Despite flood, 'it’s business as usual' for Iris Kirby House, says chair
canada.summary: A malfunctioning sprinkler forced the closure of the Iris Kirby House’s shelter earlier this week, but the board wants people to know it's working with other organizations to find a more stable shelter solution and the crisis line and other services are still available.
